subject: gk
question: Which of the following Union Ministries of India launched a pilot ‘Pey Jal Survekshan’ on 16 February 2021?

options.text: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change

solution: The correct answer is the __**Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs**__. __ • **Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs** launched a pilot **‘Pey Jal Survekshan’ on 16 February 2021.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** • The** pilot ‘Pey Jal Survekshan **has been launched in 10 cities- **Agra, Badlapur, Bhubaneswar, Churu, Kochi, Madurai, Patiala, Rohtak, Surat, and Tumkur.** • The main objective is to ascertain the **equitable distribution of water, reuse of wastewater, and mapping of water bodies concerning quantity and quality of water** through a challenging process.
